results.system_description: V atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 13 up and 10 down electrons
results.source_location: Supplementary Table 7, 'Atom' column
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained LapNet from MCMC sampling without parameter updates; total energy and standard error from a reblocking analysis (Sec. 4).
results.notes: Isolated atom, from the ionization-potential table of Fig. 4a. N_up = 13, N_down = 10 (M_S = S of the 4F ground term of V): not printed; inferred as the high-spin sector that the FermiNet-based code assigns by Hund's rule. A calculation in a lower M_S sector has the same exact energy but is another instance.

results.system_description: Fe+ cation, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 15 up and 10 down electrons
results.source_location: Supplementary Table 7, 'Ion' column
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained LapNet from MCMC sampling without parameter updates; total energy and standard error from a reblocking analysis (Sec. 4).
results.notes: Isolated cation, from the ionization-potential table of Fig. 4a. N_up = 15, N_down = 10 (M_S = S of the 6D ground term of Fe+): not printed; inferred as the high-spin sector that the FermiNet-based code assigns by Hund's rule. For a cation the code takes the spin of the isoelectronic neutral atom (Mn for Fe+), which here is that of the ground term of the cation. A calculation in a lower M_S sector has the same exact energy but is another instance.
